Flying?Block.name: Flying question block main
summary: Sprites $83 (flies left) and $84 (bobs and hovers): a winged ? block. Y speed oscillates by 1 every other frame between $F4 and $0C;
sprite $84 also oscillates X speed (+-1 every 4th frame, limit $F0/$10, 32-frame pause at each end). Mario can stand on it and be carried.
When hit from below ([$1558] = 8) it advances [$C2], spawns its contents (DATA_01AE88, chosen by [$151C]; small Mario gets different entries)
and bounces using DATA_01AE7F. Tile $2A while in state 0, $2E after. Wings are drawn only in state 0 (CODE_019E95).

s01AE7F.name: Table: block bounce offsets
summary: Y pixel offsets for the hit bounce animation, indexed by [$1558] / 2.

s01AE88.name: Table: flying block contents
summary: Contents IDs for CODE_02887D, indexed by [$151C] (+4 if Mario is small). 1 mushroom, 2 flower, 4 feather, 5 1-Up, 6 probably coin.

s01AE90.name: Init: palace switch (nothing to do)
summary: Return stub used as the init routine of sprite $60.

PalaceSwitch.name: Main: palace switch
summary: Sprite $60 main routine: runs CODE_02CD2D in bank 2.

InitThwomp.name: Init Thwomp
summary: Remembers the starting Y position in [$151C] (to return to after a fall) and shifts X right by 8 pixels.

Thwomp.name: Thwomp main
summary: Draws the Thwomp, then (only if status 8 and sprites not locked) offscreen-checks, interacts with Mario and runs the state routine from [$C2].

ThwompStatePtrs.name: Thwomp states: wait, fall, rise
summary: Pointer table, then the three state routines.
State 0: waits. Face [$1528]: 0 neutral, 1 when Mario is within +-$40 horizontally, 2 (angry) and drops when Mario is roughly underneath.
State 1: falls (Y speed +4 up to $3E); on landing shakes the ground (RAM_ShakeGrndTimer = $18), plays sound $09 and waits $40 frames.
State 2: after the wait, rises at Y speed $F0 until back at [$151C], then returns to state 0.

ThwompDispX.name: Table: Thwomp tile X offsets
summary: Four corners then the face tile.

ThwompDispY.name: Table: Thwomp tile Y offsets
summary: Four corners then the face tile.

ThwompTiles.name: Table: Thwomp tile numbers
summary: Corners $8E/$AE, face $C8 ($CA for the angry face).

ThwompGfxProp.name: Table: Thwomp tile properties
summary: Palette/flip bits ORed with [$64].

ThwompGfx.name: Draw Thwomp
summary: Draws four 16x16 corner tiles; the face tile (index 4) is added only when [$1528] is non-zero ($CA instead of $C8 when it is 2).
Finishes through CODE_01B37E with A = 4 (5 tiles) and size 16x16.

Thwimp.name: Thwimp main
summary: Sprite $27. Hops: waits $40 frames on the ground (sound $01), then jumps with Y speed $A0 and X speed alternating $10/$F0 by [$C2] bit 0.
Gravity +8 when falling (+3 while rising), terminal Y speed $40; ceiling contact sets Y speed $10. Drawn with SubSprGfx0Entry0.

InitVerticalFish.name: Init vertical Cheep Cheep
summary: Faces Mario and sets [$151C] = 1 (vertical swimmer).

s01B012.name: Table: fish initial X speeds
summary: Right, left.

InitFish.name: Init Cheep Cheep: swim toward Mario
summary: X speed = DATA_01B012 indexed by the side Mario is on.

s01B01D.name: Tables: Cheep Cheep speeds and masks
summary: Swim X/Y speeds, kill-kick X speeds, flop speeds out of water and wall-contact masks.

Fish.name: Cheep Cheep main
summary: Sprites $15/$16. In water ([$164A] set) swims back and forth, reversing on wall contact or every $80 frames; vertical ones swim up/down.
Out of water it flops: random X/Y speeds on each ground contact, random Y flip and turning. Contact hurts Mario, unless the fish is out of water or Mario has a star, then it is kicked away.
Also contains: $01B10A (animate and draw), $01B12A (kill: knocked away, 10 points) and $01B14E (spawns a random water bubble, called by other sprites).

GeneratedFish.name: Generated Cheep Cheep main
summary: Sprite $17, created by the fish generator. Flies with gravity (+1 per frame up to Y speed $20), interacts and draws via CODE_01B209.

s01B1B1.name: Table: jumping fish Y speeds
summary: Jump Y speed by state: $D0, $D0, $B0.

JumpingFish.name: Surface jumping Cheep Cheep main
summary: Sprite $18. [$C2] counts jumps 0-3; each time it is in water it jumps with Y speed from DATA_01B1B1; state 3 is a longer rise.
When it leaves the water in state 3 it resets to state 0 and jumps again with Y speed $D0. Ends in the shared interact/draw code at $01B209.

s01B212.name: Table: floating spike ball X speeds
summary: Right, left, fast right, fast left.

InitFloatSpkBall.name: Init floating spike ball
summary: Faces Mario, picks an X speed by direction (faster if X position bit 4 is set), then falls into InitFloatingPlat.

InitFallingPlat.name: Init falling platform
summary: Sets animation frame [$1602] (long platform), then continues into InitOrangePlat.

InitOrangePlat.name: Init orange platform
summary: If [$190E] is set (probably a water level flag) floats it in water via InitFloatingPlat, else state [$C2] = 1.

InitFloatingPlat.name: Init platform floating in water
summary: Moves the sprite down 8 pixels at a time (checking block interaction) until it is in water ([$164A] set), at most 4 times.
If it never finds water the status is set back to 1 (initialization).

InitChckbrdPlat.name: Init checkerboard platform
summary: Sets animation frame [$1602] = 1 (long version).

s01B268.name: Tables: platform speed steps and limits
summary: Speed step -1/+1, and the speed limits $F0/$10.

Platforms.name: Moving platforms main
summary: Sprites $55-$58 (checkerboard / flying rock platforms, horizontal and vertical). Speed ramps +-1 every 4th frame to +-$10 and back,
pausing at each end ($18 frames, 8 for sprite $55). Moves in X for sprites below $57, otherwise Y. Mario rides it via CODE_01B457 and [$1528].

s01B2C3.name: Table: platform draw styles
summary: Indexed by sprite number - $55. 0 = checkerboard tiles drawn by CODE_01B2D1, 1 = alternate routine at CODE_01B395.

s01B2D1.name: Draw checkerboard platform
summary: Draws a 3-tile wide (frame 0, tiles $60,$61,$62) or 5-tile wide (frame 1, tiles $EA,$EB,$EB,$EB,$EC) platform of 16x16 tiles.
Other platform types jump to CODE_01B395.

DiagPlatTiles.name: Table: diagonal platform tiles
summary: Tile numbers. Probably a leftover copy: bank 3 has its own DiagPlatTiles.
